morphology.pattern_note: 单音节独立词，无词缀或音变。以下词族成员为复合表达，不是派生词。

word_family.gloss: 免通行费的；电话免付费的

senses.zh_definition: 使用公路、桥梁等设施时须缴纳的通行费。
senses.en_definition: A fee charged for using a road, bridge, or similar passage.
senses.ms_definition: Bayaran yang dikenakan kerana menggunakan jalan raya, jambatan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 主要指费用；收费设施通常称 plaza tol 或 pondok tol。不能把 tol 泛用于所有税款、罚款或停车费。此处采用标准词典义，不把某些口语中 betul 的截短形式并入本义。[DBP：tol](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tol)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 差旅费用报销
dual_scenarios.ms: Kakitangan diminta menyertakan rekod bayaran tol semasa mengemukakan tuntutan perjalanan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 员工提交差旅报销申请时，须附上通行费缴付记录。
dual_scenarios.en: Staff are asked to include toll payment records when submitting travel expense claims.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友商量开车路线
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nak ikut jalan biasa je? Tak payah bayar tol.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Hendak melalui jalan biasa sahaja? Kita tidak perlu membayar tol.
dual_scenarios.zh: 要不走普通公路？不用付过路费。
dual_scenarios.en: Shall we take the regular road? We won't have to pay a toll.
spoken_features: nak 是 hendak 的口语形式
可从语境省略主语 kita

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak ikut jalan biasa je? Tak payah bayar tol.
messages.ms_standard: Hendak melalui jalan biasa sahaja? Kita tidak perlu membayar tol.
messages.zh: 要不走普通公路？不用付过路费。
messages.en: Shall we take the regular road? We won't have to pay a toll.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, tapi aku dah lambat ni. Ikut lebuh raya je lah, aku bayar tol.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh, tetapi aku sudah lewat. Marilah kita melalui lebuh raya sahaja; aku akan membayar tol.
messages.zh: 也行，可我已经迟了。还是走高速吧，过路费我付。
messages.en: We could, but I'm already running late. Let's take the expressway; I'll cover the toll.

etymology.historical_story: Tol belongs to the vocabulary of paid passage and resembles English toll and Dutch tol. The DBP definition establishes its modern Malay meaning but does not identify the borrowing route, so a precise donor language should not be asserted from that entry alone. Its practical cultural setting is travel: drivers discuss the charge, the payment, and the route.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tol 和英语 toll 一起记：车到收费处，付 tol 才继续走。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性词，正式文件和日常交流均可使用。询问同行者分摊费用时，可说 Boleh kita kongsi bayaran tol?。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论路线、差旅开支和费用分摊。bebas tol 在电话语境中也可表示免付费，须结合语境理解。[DBP：bebas tol](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=bebas)
